propositions: The primary comment deduplication guard is_comment_mapped never populated its backing map comment_ids from the feature's first production run (2026-08-15) until the fix landed (2026-08-21), making the guard inert for six days rather than months.

No test exercises the seam between comment-id recording and subsequent differ-layer dedup skips; each layer seeds the invariants the other layer assumes, so tests pass with the primary skip disabled end-to-end.

Plan-review criteria E4, T3, and T5b all abstain or stop short of the external-response-schema dependency that 789c introduced; the code-review rubric naming fail-open guards was added post-escape in response to this and eight other instances.

A silent guard returning on multiple error paths with no logging, no raise, and no metric movement created an unobservable invariant violation: comment_ids stayed empty while bindings grew to 2475 and outbound posts continued succeeding.
